annotations.title: Has this company written down what it bought?

description: Use when the user asks whether a company has impaired a brand or an acquisition, is preparing to sell a brand to a strategic buyer, or wants to know how acquirers have valued past deals. Returns every fiscal year in which the company tagged a goodwill or intangible impairment in its 10-K XBRL, with the amount by line (goodwill, brands and trademarks, other intangibles) and each filing's citation. Refuses before you are charged if none is tagged. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: built in: every fiscal year tagged. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For deal activity across a sector, use run_deal_activity.
